answer: An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the gale check immediately, the signal audit keeps the resolved set and the sable replay exposes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 172 aliases thus pays the reading cost 172 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
